name: Deodorant
description: Guidelines for traveling with deodorant in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Solid stick deodorant is fully allowed in carry-on with no size limit. Liquid, gel, or aerosol deodorants must be 3.4 oz or less.

checkedBag.reason: All types of deodorant are allowed in checked baggage in any quantity.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring deodorant on a plane?

travelTips: Solid stick deodorant is fully allowed in carry-on with no size limit. Liquid, gel, or aerosol deodorants must be 3.4 oz or less.

faq.question: Is deodorant allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Deodorant is restricted in carry-on luggage. Solid stick deodorant is fully allowed in carry-on with no size limit. Liquid, gel, or aerosol deodorants must be 3.4 oz or less.

faq.question: Can you pack deodorant in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Deodorant is allowed in checked bags. All types of deodorant are allowed in checked baggage in any quantity.
